sources.title: Require payments for appointments
sources.claimSpecificReview: Complete body read: eligible Workspace/administrator gate; Stripe connection; required payment setup; cancellation does not automatically refund; Stripe handles refund; disconnect removes payment requirement from all schedules.

sources.title: Verify emails for appointments
sources.claimSpecificReview: Complete body read: eligible Workspace, verification initially off, schedule booking-form checkbox, signed-in Google users not asked for PIN, guest inbox PIN workflow.

sources.title: Share your appointment schedule
sources.claimSpecificReview: Complete body read: booking-page public identity; direct link, popup button and inline embed; one booking page versus all booking pages; calendar-list visibility does not hide the booking page.

sources.title: View how you spend time in meetings
sources.claimSpecificReview: Complete body read: primary-calendar and computer access; qualifying Yes/Busy/guest/duration criteria; range-dependent averages; overlapping meeting intervals counted once. Worked 90-minute example is author arithmetic, not runtime observation.

sources.title: Use Google Calendar offline
sources.claimSpecificReview: Complete computer body read: Chrome offline setup/reload/readiness, previous four weeks and future view, no creation/edit/guest email/tasks, clearing cache removes support. Mobile behavior not generalized.

sources.title: Use keyboard shortcuts in Google Calendar
sources.claimSpecificReview: Complete computer body read: enable shortcuts, question-mark reference, specific date/week/create/Escape and platform save commands; avoid relying on unknown focus or using delete experimentally.

sources.title: Add or remove alternate calendars
sources.claimSpecificReview: Complete computer body read: alternate lunar/solar display through View options; Moon-phase and sports sources through calendars of interest; no claim every team is available.

sources.title: Find and install Calendar add-ons
sources.claimSpecificReview: Complete computer body read: Marketplace installation, administrator restrictions, event conferencing dropdown and provider sign-in, uninstall limits and provider support. No assumption that uninstall revokes every grant or edits invitations.

sources.title: Show personal & work calendars in Google Calendar
sources.claimSpecificReview: Complete Android body read and web corroboration: managed Work Profile plus administrator allowance, separate storage, personal-calendar connection, direct sharing distinction and duplicate-route control. Not a blanket device-management privacy guarantee.

sources.title: Let Gemini in Google Calendar find times to meet
sources.claimSpecificReview: Complete computer body read: eligible Workspace, guest-based suggested times/create/reschedule workflow, mobile/long-duration/past-range exclusions; no invented numerical guest limit or room acceptance guarantee.

sources.title: Report assigned tasks as spam
sources.claimSpecificReview: Complete computer body read: assigned-task report removes personal-list entry and assignment in shared space; Tasks side panel or Calendar task menu; no claim of deleting source document or banning every sender.

sources.title: Track responses to your event
sources.claimSpecificReview: Complete computer body read and web corroboration: calendar-wide response mail versus per-event/series checkbox, disabling per-event response mail excludes third-party RSVP status including Outlook; no historical-backfill promise.
